This confirms it: there is no `DELETE /api/character/:id` or session-deletion endpoint at all — only item-drop deletion exists. So deleting a campaign slot never calls the backend.

## Login
`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts` — `AuthService.login(username)` is purely client-side: it looks up `localStorage['ai_dnd_user_<lowercased name>']`, and either loads that `UserProfile` or creates a new empty one (`{username, campaigns: []}`) and persists it via `persist()` to both that per-user key and `ai_dnd_user`. There's no password/server auth at all — `login.component.ts`'s `login()` just calls this and routes to `/characters` or shows saved campaign slots.

## Campaigns
Stored client-side only, inside each `UserProfile.campaigns: CampaignSlot[]` array in `localStorage` (keys `ai_dnd_user_<username>` / `ai_dnd_user`), defined in `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`. Each `CampaignSlot` just holds `slotId`, `sessionId`, `characterId`, level, etc. — pointers into the server's data, not the data itself. Real game state lives server-side: the character row in D1 (`worker/src/services/character.ts`, queried via `getCharacter`), and the session object in Workers KV (`worker/src/services/session.ts`, `loadSession`/`saveSession`), keyed by `sessionId`.

## Deleting a campaign slot
`LoginComponent.deleteCampaign()` → `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)` only splices the entry out of the local `campaigns` array and rewrites localStorage. **No backend request is made** — there's no DELETE route for character or session in `worker/src/index.ts`/`routes/character.ts`/`routes/session.ts` (only `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` exists, for dropping items). So the D1 character row and the KV session remain fully intact server-side; they're just orphaned (no longer reachable from the UI) until KV's TTL naturally expires the session.
